items.html: And indeed, Ima and ZON of Assiyah were also diminished, and there is in each of them only the aspect of three within three. And the difference among them is that Ima has no Makif, and ZA has one Makif, and the Nukva two Makifim. And behold, also in Assiyah there is the aspect of Atik, which is the point of Malchut of Yetzirah that descended to Assiyah and was clothed in AA.
